svg.text: APPROVALS FARM · ROOM IO + GAMEPLAY READ
Applications enter by tube; adjudicators convert one unit per seat; determinations aggregate at the Docket Rack.
FOOTSTEPS WITHIN · TUBES ONLY AT THE ROOM EDGE

cage and a larger paper mass. Flow: one intake, rows of seats,
